subject.title: fix(gateway): redact Responses media blocks in chat history sanitization

question: Should this PR be held until the WebSocket proof uses a production-shaped parent-linked transcript, or may maintainers accept the current raw-transcript endpoint proof?
rationale: The code change is security-boundary-sensitive, and the repository's scoped server-methods policy explicitly rejects parentless raw transcript rows for this kind of test proof.

options.title: Require canonical endpoint proof
options.body: Have the contributor seed the WebSocket proof through `SessionManager.appendMessage(...)` or an equivalent parent-linked wrapper before merge.

options.title: Accept current proof gap
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept projection-level plus raw-fixture endpoint proof, but that weakens confidence in the stored-history redaction boundary.

recommendation.title: Require canonical endpoint proof
recommendation.body: Have the contributor seed the WebSocket proof through `SessionManager.appendMessage(...)` or an equivalent parent-linked wrapper before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the clearest recent history on the session-history sanitization and stored-history projection paths.
